svg.aria-label: Three cards. 1 An interval: two notes together, counted in letters and semitones, example C4 + E4, a major third. 2 Motion: how two voices change between pairs: oblique, contrary, similar. 3 Two lines can make changing harmony: C4 + F4, a perfect fourth, against B3 + F4, a diminished fifth, under the same upper note.
